datasets.name: UCI Bank Marketing
datasets.description: Portuguese bank direct-marketing campaign outcomes. Each row represents a client contacted during a campaign; the target indicates whether the client subscribed to a term deposit.
example_questions: How many clients are in the dataset?
How many clients subscribed to a term deposit?
What is the average age of clients?
How many clients have a housing loan?
Which contact method was used most often?

datasets.name: TPC-H SF1
datasets.description: Snowflake's standard TPC-H SF1 sample data. The eight configured tables cover customers, orders, order line items, parts, suppliers, nations, and regions. Use configured join keys to answer questions across these related records.
example_questions: How many customer records are in the sample?
What is the average order total price?
How many orders were placed by BUILDING-segment customers?
Which three nations have the most orders?
How many suppliers belong to each region?
